hierarchy.section: Top-level semantic block such as Listening, Reading, Speaking Set or a scoring/methodology block.
hierarchy.task: One assessable instruction/stimulus unit. Task numbering may restart inside sections or repeated sets.
hierarchy.part: A nested assessable operation sharing a parent task/stimulus.
hierarchy.artifact: A visual/structured object required to understand or answer a task.

rules: Do not promote numbered answer items to TASK when an explicit Task/Problem/Question heading exists above them.
Repeated numbering is allowed inside different sections or repeated sets.
A compound task stays one TASK when multiple parts share one instruction/stimulus or later parts depend on earlier output.
Crosswords, grids, diagrams, tables and equation regions are ARTIFACT nodes attached to TASK/PART rather than flattened into prose.
When structure is uncertain, preserve an UNKNOWN task/part with evidence instead of inventing a confident label.
Page span and evidence anchor are separate: an anchor may identify the heading while the span covers several pages.
